sections.label: B
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Write the word that matches each definition.

questions.prompt: 1. The ___ has a lot of bushes and trees.
questions.explanation: A thicket is a dense area of bushes and small trees.

questions.prompt: 2. A ___ is a dried grape. It is small and brown.
questions.explanation: A dried grape is called a raisin.

questions.prompt: 3. A ___ is yellow and black and can sting you — be careful!
questions.explanation: A bee is a yellow-and-black insect that can sting.

sections.label: C
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Write the missing insect, then choose the original picture label. The letters label the pictures only.

sections.label: D
sections.title: Circle the correct words.
sections.note: Choose the past continuous form that agrees with the subject.

questions.prompt: 1. The children was playing / were playing outside yesterday.
questions.explanation: Children is plural, so use were playing.

questions.prompt: 2. The animals wasn't eating / weren't eating the leaves of the trees.
questions.explanation: Animals is plural, so use weren't eating.

questions.prompt: 3. Was / Were the students learning about insects?
questions.explanation: Students is plural, so the question begins with Were.

questions.prompt: 4. The bird wasn't flying / weren't flying in the sky.
questions.explanation: The bird is singular, so use wasn't flying.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Use the past continuous form of the verbs in parentheses.
sections.note: Use was or were + verb-ing. The picture helps you identify the positive or negative form.

questions.prompt: 1. Kevin ___ to the teacher. (listen)
questions.explanation: Kevin is singular, and the picture shows that he was not listening, so use wasn't listening.

questions.prompt: 2. I ___ a poem. (write)
questions.explanation: With I, the past continuous is was + writing.

questions.prompt: 3. The sun ___. (shine)
questions.explanation: The picture shows rain and no sunshine, so use wasn't shining.

questions.prompt: 4. The children ___ baseball. (play)
questions.explanation: Children is plural, so use were + playing.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the word box. One phrase is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. What ___ yesterday?
questions.explanation: A past continuous question with you uses were you doing.

questions.prompt: 2. The birds ___ in the middle of the night.
questions.explanation: Birds is plural, so the negative past continuous form is weren't singing.

questions.prompt: 3. My sister ___ a delicious breakfast this morning.
questions.explanation: My sister is singular, so use was cooking.

questions.prompt: 4. Delia ___ because it was 2:00 in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Delia is singular, so the negative past continuous form is wasn't sleeping.

sections.label: G
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the word box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. What words can ___ what this animal looks like?
questions.explanation: Describe means to say what someone or something is like.

questions.prompt: 2. Cat, hat, and mat are ___.
questions.explanation: These words rhyme because they share the same ending sound.

questions.prompt: 3. I ___ your country is very beautiful!
questions.explanation: Imagine means to form an idea or picture in your mind.

questions.prompt: 4. The word happy has two ___.
questions.explanation: Happy has two spoken beats: hap-py.

questions.prompt: 5. I like to ___ birds flying in the sky.
questions.explanation: Observe means to watch something carefully.

questions.prompt: 6. Haiku poems have an ___ number of syllables per line.
questions.explanation: Exact means completely correct and fixed, not approximate.

questions.prompt: 1. Happy, sad, and beautiful are adjectives.
questions.explanation: These words describe feelings or qualities, so they are adjectives.

questions.prompt: 2. You can see snowflakes in the summer.
questions.explanation: Snowflakes normally form in cold winter weather, not summer.

questions.prompt: 3. Bird, tree, and table are verbs.
questions.explanation: Bird, tree, and table name things, so they are nouns.

questions.prompt: 4. The word mountain has eight letters.
questions.explanation: Mountain is spelled m-o-u-n-t-a-i-n: eight letters.

sections.label: I
sections.title: Look and complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the picture to write the correct word.

questions.prompt: 1. An ___ swims in the ocean.
questions.explanation: The picture shows an angelfish.

questions.prompt: 2. A ___ sings in the tree.
questions.explanation: The picture shows a robin on a branch.

questions.prompt: 3. A ___ begins with a capital letter and ends with a period.
questions.explanation: A complete sentence begins with a capital letter and ends with punctuation.

questions.prompt: 4. A ___ is a person, place, or thing.
questions.explanation: A noun names a person, place, thing, or idea.

sections.label: K
sections.title: Check the correct answer.
sections.note: Choose the option that completes each sentence correctly.

questions.prompt: 1. I was sleeping when the plane ___.
questions.explanation: Both actions are in the past: the plane landed while I was sleeping.

questions.prompt: 2. ___ when it started to snow?
questions.explanation: A past continuous question uses Were + subject + verb-ing.

questions.prompt: 3. Manisha was walking in the park when she ___ a butterfly.
questions.explanation: Saw is the simple past event that happened during the longer action was walking.

sections.label: L
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Write each complete sentence and choose its original picture label. Each item is worth one point, so both parts must be correct.

questions.prompt: 1. was / cleaning / when / the phone / rang / Mary / the kitchen

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: Mary was cleaning the kitchen when the phone rang.
Mary was cleaning the kitchen when the phone rang
parts.explanation: Use past continuous for the longer action and simple past for the interrupting event.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows Mary cleaning the kitchen.

questions.prompt: 2. were / rain / swimming / when / We / it / started / to

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: We were swimming when it started to rain.
We were swimming when it started to rain
parts.explanation: Were swimming is the action in progress; started is the shorter past event.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture b shows people swimming when it started to rain.

questions.prompt: 3. when / Ahmed / fell / a book / asleep / he / reading / was

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: Ahmed was reading a book when he fell asleep.
Ahmed was reading a book when he fell asleep
parts.explanation: Was reading is the longer action; fell asleep is the event that happened during it.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture a shows Ahmed asleep with a book.

questions.prompt: 4. walking / a robin / when / I / in the thicket / I / saw / was

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: I was walking in the thicket when I saw a robin.
I was walking in the thicket when I saw a robin
parts.explanation: Was walking is the background action; saw is the shorter event.
